question: Which web analytics, product analytics and data tooling free tiers should the next discover unit add, after Amplitude, Mixpanel, Statsig, Heap, Hotjar, GoatCounter, Aptabase and Umami Cloud? First DevDome (50,000 human pageviews a month, unlimited sites, 90 days of data), HitKeep (3 websites, 3 team members, 60-day retention), Beampipe (5 domains, 10k monthly page views), Cabin (1 site, 10k page views a month), Rybbit and Seline (3,000 events a month each), getinsights.io (3k events a month), Gizmo Analytics, AppFit, LogSpot and TraceLog (10k events a month each), Clicky (3000 views; the address clicky.com/pricing answered HTTP 404, so the live pricing page must be found), TrackWith Dicloud (3 domains, 600 session replays per domain), counter.dev, StatCounter, Stats4U, Moesif (500,000 API calls a month; moesif.com/pricing/ answered HTTP 404) and Google Analytics. Then Avo, Census, Hightouch, Trackingplan, Repohistory, DocBeacon and Dwh.dev.
why: These 25 vendors of the Analytics, Events and Statistics section state a free tier on the free-for.dev list and have no record; none was read by this unit, and Clicky and Moesif need their live pricing page found first.
